benefit: Buckwheat sown adjacent to strawberry blocks extends pollinator availability beyond the short strawberry bloom and supports lacewing and minute pirate bug populations that suppress lygus and tarnished plant bugs.

members.title: Buckwheat strip 3 weeks before strawberry bloom
members.body: Drill buckwheat at 60 lb per acre in a 12 ft strip beside the strawberry block, three weeks before bloom. Mow before seed-set to avoid volunteers.
